# SpecimenSet schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of specimen sets: tissue or cultures prepared together.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Additional fields

- type code `Array` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/Array/1.0.1.json)

Any extra parameters you want to add to this specimen set. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `key` | key | text |  |  |  |
| `value` | value | object |  |  |  |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "key": "text",
        "value": {}
    }
]
```


## Culture

- type code `Culture` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/Culture/1.0.1.json)

Describes a culture of cells or tissue, such as organotypic slices on inserts, with how it was established, format, day 0 event, growth surface and coating, medium, incubator settings and termination reason.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `culturePreparation` | Culture preparation | choice |  | one of `primary_dissociated`, `primary_explant`, `organotypic_slice`, `immortalized_line`, `stem_cell_derived`, `other` | How the cultured material was obtained and prepared when the culture was established. |
| `cultureFormat` | Culture format | choice |  | one of `submerged`, `static_suspension`, `orbital_shaker`, `spinning_bioreactor`, `roller_tube`, `microwell_array`, `air_liquid_interface`, `perfused`, `other` | Physical format the culture is currently held in. |
| `ageReferenceEvent` | Day 0 event | choice |  | one of `dissection`, `dissociation_or_plating`, `sectioning`, `thaw`, `aggregate_formation`, `neural_induction`, `matrix_embedding`, `other` | Event the culture's day count is reckoned from (day 0). |
| `passageAtEstablishment` | Passage at establishment | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Passage number of the source material when this culture was established, as labelled on the vial or bank record; empty for primary cultures. |
| `itemsPerContainer` | Specimens per vessel | integer |  | ≥ 1 | Nominal number of specimens in each dish, well or insert (e.g., 3 slices per insert). |
| `substrate` | Growth surface | text |  |  | Surface or support the culture grows on, without its coating. |
| `coating` | Coating | multi-select |  | one of `none`, `poly_l_lysine`, `poly_d_lysine`, `poly_ornithine`, `laminin`, `fibronectin`, `collagen_i`, `collagen_iv`, `gelatin`, `vitronectin`, `basement_membrane_matrix`, `other`; format select2 | Coatings applied to the growth surface; select every one used. |
| `medium` | Medium | text |  |  | Medium the culture is kept in, as prepared, recorded as a single label. |
| `incubationTemperature` | Incubation temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`, `K`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | Incubator temperature the culture is kept at, as set rather than as measured. |
| `co2Concentration` | CO₂ level | quantity with unit |  | units `% v/v`, `ppm`; default `{"unit": "% v/v"}` | CO₂ level of the incubator atmosphere, as set rather than as measured. |
| `oxygenTension` | O₂ level | quantity with unit |  | units `% v/v`, `ppm`; default `{"unit": "% v/v"}` | O₂ level of the incubator atmosphere, as set rather than as measured; not dissolved oxygen. |
| `humidification` | Humidification | choice |  | one of `humidified`, `humidity_controlled`, `not_humidified` | How the incubator atmosphere is humidified, as set. |
| `terminationReason` | Termination reason | choice |  | one of `consumed`, `contamination_bacterial_or_fungal`, `contamination_mycoplasma`, `failed_to_establish`, `poor_health`, `endpoint_reached`, `storage_or_equipment_failure`, `other` | Why the culture ended, recorded when it was terminated. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "culturePreparation": "primary_dissociated",
    "cultureFormat": "submerged"
}
```


## Organoid batch

- type code `OrganoidBatch` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/OrganoidBatch/1.0.1.json)

Describes a production run of organoids, which may span several vessels, with batch ID, day 0 event, differentiation protocol type, culture format, agitation, medium and incubator settings.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | The lab's code for this production run, which may span several vessels. |
| `ageReferenceEvent` | Day 0 event | choice |  | one of `dissection`, `dissociation_or_plating`, `sectioning`, `thaw`, `aggregate_formation`, `neural_induction`, `matrix_embedding`, `other` | Event the batch's day count is reckoned from (day 0). |
| `guidanceMode` | Guidance mode | choice |  | one of `unguided`, `guided` | Kind of differentiation protocol the run follows. |
| `cultureFormat` | Culture format | choice |  | one of `submerged`, `static_suspension`, `orbital_shaker`, `spinning_bioreactor`, `roller_tube`, `microwell_array`, `air_liquid_interface`, `perfused`, `other` | Physical culture format currently in effect for the batch. |
| `agitationRate` | Agitation rate | quantity with unit |  | units `RPM`, `Hz`; default `{"unit": "RPM"}` | Rotational speed the batch is agitated at, as set on the shaker or bioreactor. |
| `medium` | Medium | text |  |  | Medium the batch is declared to be kept in, as prepared, recorded as a single label. |
| `incubationTemperature` | Incubation temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`, `K`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | Incubator temperature the batch is kept at, as set rather than as measured. |
| `co2Concentration` | CO₂ level | quantity with unit |  | units `% v/v`, `ppm`; default `{"unit": "% v/v"}` | CO₂ level of the incubator atmosphere, as set rather than as measured. |
| `humidification` | Humidification | choice |  | one of `humidified`, `humidity_controlled`, `not_humidified` | How the incubator atmosphere is humidified, as set. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "batchId": "text",
    "ageReferenceEvent": "dissection"
}
```


## Other

- type code `Other` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/Other/1.0.1.json)

Describes a set of ex-vivo material that none of the other specimen set types fits.

This type has no type-specific properties: send an empty object. Everything meaningful is recorded on the record itself or on its material usage rows.


## Section series

- type code `SectionSeries` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/SectionSeries/1.1.1.json)

Describes a series of sections cut from the same tissue, with cutting plane, the axis and origin used to position sections, default thickness, sections per slide and the slide box or plate holding the series.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `orientation` | Orientation | text |  |  | Anatomical plane in which the sections of this series were cut; for an oblique cut, state the plane it deviates from. |
| `coordinateAxis` | Coordinate axis | text |  |  | Axis along which section positions in this series are indexed and measured. |
| `coordinateOrigin` | Coordinate origin | text |  |  | Landmark from which section positions in this series are measured. |
| `defaultThickness` | Default thickness | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | Nominal thickness of the sections in this series; a section's own thickness overrides it. |
| `itemsPerContainer` | Sections per slide | integer |  | ≥ 1 | Nominal number of sections mounted on each slide of this series; the last slide may hold fewer. |
| `containerId` | Container ID | text |  |  | Label on the one slide box or plate holding the whole series; empty when the series spans several carriers. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "orientation": "text",
    "coordinateAxis": "text"
}
```


## Slice series

- type code `SliceSeries` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/SliceSeries/1.1.1.json)

Describes a series of living slices, such as acute brain slices, with cutting plane, the axis and origin used to position slices, default thickness and the holding solution.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `orientation` | Orientation | text |  |  | Anatomical or preparation plane in which the slices of this series were cut; for an oblique cut, state the plane it deviates from. |
| `coordinateAxis` | Coordinate axis | text |  |  | Axis along which slice positions in this series are indexed and measured. |
| `coordinateOrigin` | Coordinate origin | text |  |  | Landmark from which slice positions in this series are measured. |
| `defaultThickness` | Default thickness | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | Nominal slice thickness declared for this series; a slice's own recorded thickness overrides it. |
| `holdingSolution` | Holding solution | text |  |  | Solution the living slices were declared to be held in between cutting and use. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "orientation": "text",
    "coordinateAxis": "text"
}
```


## Well plate

- type code `WellPlate` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/WellPlate/1.0.1.json)

Describes a multi-well plate or chambered slide, with its label, format, edge-well handling, coating and incubator settings. Individual wells are recorded as Well specimens.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `containerId` | Container ID | text |  |  | Label or barcode on the plate itself, as written on the lid or read by a scanner. |
| `plateFormat` | Plate format | choice |  | one of `1_well`, `2_well`, `4_well`, `6_well`, `8_well`, `12_well`, `24_well`, `48_well`, `96_well`, `384_well`, `1536_well`, `other` | Number of wells on the plate or chambered slide. |
| `edgeWellPolicy` | Edge-well policy | choice |  | one of `used`, `buffer_filled`, `left_empty`, `seeded_but_excluded`, `other` | How the plate's outer ring of wells was handled. |
| `coating` | Coating | multi-select |  | one of `none`, `poly_l_lysine`, `poly_d_lysine`, `poly_ornithine`, `laminin`, `fibronectin`, `collagen_i`, `collagen_iv`, `gelatin`, `vitronectin`, `basement_membrane_matrix`, `other`; format select2 | Coating on the wells' growth surface; select every layer applied. |
| `incubationTemperature` | Incubation temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`, `K`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | Temperature the plate was kept at, as set on the incubator rather than as measured. |
| `co2Concentration` | CO₂ level | quantity with unit |  | units `% v/v`, `ppm`; default `{"unit": "% v/v"}` | CO₂ level of the incubator atmosphere the plate was kept in, as set rather than as measured. |
| `humidification` | Humidification | choice |  | one of `humidified`, `humidity_controlled`, `not_humidified` | How the incubator atmosphere was humidified, as set. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "containerId": "text",
    "plateFormat": "1_well"
}
```


## Whole tissue

- type code `WholeTissue` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenSet/WholeTissue/1.1.1.json)

Describes an intact tissue or organ kept whole, such as an extracted brain, with the label of its container when held in one.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `containerId` | Container ID | text |  |  | Label on the one jar, vial or bag holding all of this tissue; empty when the tissue is split across several containers. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "containerId": "text"
}
```
